forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: 35%? That's a huge leap. But is this Microsoft selling more security solutions?

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: Rapid adoption of AI without adequate security measures. Companies are rushing in to capitalize on AI advantages without fully understanding the risks.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: That’s quite a turnaround. And with all these advancements, Rubrik’s warning about security gaps in Agentic AI adoption is something to keep an eye on. They published their findings on April 16th as well.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: [laughs] More than patches. Microsoft emphasizes creating a culture of security—thinking ahead of potential vulnerabilities.
